patterns.pattern: Existing `manage-branch` rule not followed: resuming an existing issue branch with `git checkout` and `git merge main` instead of `git switch` and `update-branch.ts`, as the skill wasn't loaded when not creating a branch
Removing a config file after checking only one tool that reads it, e.g. deleting `.npmrc` because pnpm stopped reading it, while npm still needed its `engine-strict` for the `engines` guard
Running a command that prompts when an allowlisted one does the same job, e.g. `npm view` instead of `pnpm view`
Existing memory "several topics: list with summaries, detail one at a time" not followed: detailing every review finding in one reply
A markdown list numbered out of order, e.g. a reviewer's 1, 3, 4, 5, rendered as 1, 2, 3, 4 so the numbers no longer matched the findings

Existing memory "check the library's docs before building bespoke machinery" not followed: extending `useWaitForServerValue` before checking TanStack Query's own pattern of writing mutation results into the query cache
Existing `CLAUDE.md` rule not followed: running a whole long E2E game, e.g. the Winner Chooses project, to check a step at its start, rather than stopping once past it
A game's docs given a section for a new option but no overview of the options around it, e.g. a Dealer section without a breakdown of all the Yaniv settings
An implementation detail written into a game's rules doc, e.g. which emoji reaction replaces another, when it only matters for building the game
Separate rules merged into one sentence of a doc, e.g. a dealt card's magic and its four-in-a-row effect in Setup, rather than each going in the section it belongs to

Existing `run-retro` step 4 "find what actually went wrong" not followed: drafting a rule around where the work came from (a PR's review) rather than why it belonged in the PR (the PR's own change made it necessary)

Code that doesn't read the way the rule is applied by hand, so it's harder to follow than it needs to be, e.g. `getVisibleDiscardCards` should look at the top cards first and only read further down the pile when they call for it

A new function added where extending an existing one would do, and named outside the domain's terms, e.g. `drawCardsUpTo` beside `drawCards`, which could mean drawing up to a hand size or up to a count, when an option on `drawCards` kept one term for drawing (a glossary, #356, would give the terms)

Existing `CLAUDE.md` rule "explain how only in code that is rarely touched but important" not followed: a store's doc comment describing its Redis calls, e.g. `drainDiscard` "fetches and clears the rest in one batch", rather than what it does for the caller
Part of an issue's scope named only in its title left undone, e.g. #462 "Expire and clean up discard piles" fixed only the expiry until the user asked about existing entries

An allowlisted skill script prompting as "too complex" because its heredoc body contains a shell snippet with nested quotes or `$` variables, e.g. `update-pr.ts` with an `awk '{ print … $1 … }'` command in the PR description

Existing `CLAUDE.md` rule "look for layout shift between states" not followed: a control moving when a sibling's text changes between states, e.g. the Ready switch shifting as the Start button's label changed width
A view showing the player's unsaved edits where the server's values would confirm the change went through, e.g. your own lobby tag following the name and colour inputs rather than the saved player

Existing `CLAUDE.md` rule on reduced motion not followed: reusing a shared component whose motion ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`, e.g. `CelebrationRain`, and leaving it because the player starts it, until a review raised it
A visible heading added over content whose meaning is already clear, e.g. "Finishing order" above a list of 1st, 2nd and 3rd, which the user first called bland and then removed
